active_DB_snapshot.edition_scope: Core Set / Misty Vale, не вся линейка Drakar och Demoner

creation_basis.reason: Ноль заменён экспертным диапазоном 1/5/15%: есть собственный sandbox с адаптацией путешествий и заказанная карта мира Dormir. Активная аудитория M остаётся старым слабым прокси.

findings.conclusion: Separate standalone campaign is real; no basis to add its backers to DB Core active M or count language versions as independent games.
Ready map and campaign are supported; expanded journeys and planned VTT content do not establish own regional-creation demand.

Relative publisher strength warrants continued DB research despite reference place39. Current M is an unobserved proxy and high-case place8 already reflects major uncertainty; this is not proof of incorrect ranking.

decision.reason: Strong funding/portfolio signal justifies the completed screen, but no comparable current-GM denominator, own-map prevalence or marginal tool demand is established. Do not infer an uplift or fabricate a numeric candidate.
decision.revisit_trigger: New direct own-world campaign evidence, comparable disclosed sales/distribution with exact edition, or actual source rules after release; date alone is not a reason to rescan.
decision.numeric_impact: No active inputs, p/M/T/R/C, places, membership, cohorts or numerical method changed.

source_exclusions.reason: Snippet showed 11,683 versus current primary page 11,684; use primary snapshot, do not infer growth from different snapshot timing.
Headline launch date differs from final funding interval; final official project period controls this record.
Web open returned403; active Core scope comes from persisted ranking, not claimed fresh full book reading.

product_consequences.reason: This is market/edition evidence, not a rules corpus. No rule was extracted from marketing and no unsupported product gap is asserted. Existing common rules and game bindings remain the only registries.
product_consequences.layer_boundary: Supplied map is L1 context; journey rule promises are L2 leads; neither authorizes integration or a new mode.

unknowns: Current active GMs and core/Trudvang overlap
English versus Swedish audience split and retail/late-pledge quantities
Actual fulfilment, preview access and executable Foundry module support
Full rule text: map scale, creation procedures and any scenario-specific requirements
Share using their own geography versus supplied Trudvang and unresolved tool need

next_candidate.action: Проверить уже собранные Y13/Y14 — свой sandbox и заказанную карту Dormir: точная редакция, созданная или готовая география, факт подготовки/игры и используемый инструмент. Сначала извлечь старые источники, не повторять поиск Trudvang.
next_candidate.completion_condition: Законченный ledger двух исходных примеров с выводом о создании карты и нерешённой задаче; если прямой корпус недоступен — выбрать независимый существенный рыночный пробел.
